response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software craftsman and Staff Engineer with strong backend and distributed systems skills. However, he lacks the executive-level engineering leadership experience (scaling teams to 30+, managing managers, board communication) and the deep, production-grade multi-agent AI and fintech-infrastructure expertise explicitly required for this CTO role.
strengths: Extensive backend and distributed systems engineering experience, including handling high-scale microservices.
Demonstrated initiative in open-source development and founding a technical data platform (GISCollective).
Recent hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and agentic workflows.
concerns: Complete lack of executive engineering leadership experience and history of scaling teams from 10 to 30+ engineers.
Missing extensive production experience building multi-agent AI systems in high-stakes, regulated environments.
Lacks deep architectural experience in fintech infrastructure, such as credit systems and algorithmic working-capital allocation.
